game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: RickyZ_PR
quote: The atmosphere feels similar yet fresh at the same time. I think is the color palettes that are more vibrant and bright that adds this feeling of uniqueness when compared with Hollow Knight's more dark and grey colors. The familiarity is still there. If you loved Hollow Knight, you will love this one. Secret rooms, goofy bugs and relentless enemies, all there. Be aware though, there is no more "pogoing" straight down (at the begnning) so you need to get used to the diagonal down-trust and learn how to bounce off the enemies to position yourself for a follow up. Background looks gorgeous and music is top notch. The melancholy themes are a treat to listen to.
